title: 第6章 当面验炼
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
“进去。”

    柳青霜在一处静室门前停下，头也不回。

    陈青山怀着一肚子心事，跟着她一路上了主峰。越往上走越冷，灵气浓得压人，脚下的青石换成了灵岩，光滑得打滑。

    一路上柳青霜一言不发，他也不敢问，就这么闷声闷气地到了这处静室。

    他推门进去，门轴吱呀一声。

    静室不大，靠窗一张长案，案上散着几块法器残片，旁边架着个小熔炉，炉膛里的余烬早灭了。

    窗边，站着一个人。

    一袭白衣，长发垂到腰间，只用一根木簪别着。陈青山只瞧了一眼，便赶紧低下头。

    柳如烟。

    器峰首席弟子。

    这种人物，他平日连远远望一眼的机会都少，更别说靠近。今天，她就站在面前，不到三丈远。

    没等他开口，柳如烟先淡淡问道：

    “你就是陈青山？”

    “弟子陈青山，见过柳师姐。”

    虽不知是怎么一回事，该有的礼数，他半点不敢少。他躬身行礼，垂着头，不敢直视。

    柳如烟没叫他起来。她走到长案前，拿起一块废器残片——巴掌大小，表面布满裂纹，灵纹断得很彻底。

    “听说，你提炼废器的手法很特别。”

    她把残片递过来。

    “当着我的面，炼一遍。”

    陈青山接住残片，手心瞬间沁出汗来。

    完了。

    当面炼。

    不能用鼎。

    可他只慌了一瞬，便逼自己冷静下来。普通熔炼的手法他练过，来器峰这些日子，天天和熔炉打交道，基本的流程闭着眼都能走一遍。提出来的精铁，纯度自然远不如鼎，可至少能交差。

    要紧的是——控住火候。

    不能太高，也不能太低。太高，露馅；太低，反倒可疑。一个先前交得出九成二精铁的人，当场只炼出六成，傻子都看得出他在藏。

    八成，正好。

    比先前低一截，可以推说是“当着首席的面，紧张失了手”，却又不至于低到惹人起疑。

    陈青山走到静室角落的公用熔炉前，催动灵力，火焰升腾，残片入炉，慢慢融化。柳如烟和柳青霜立在一旁，静静看着。那道目光，像两根针，扎在他后背上。

    他故意放慢了手。

    头一遍，出七成。第二遍，拉到八成。到第三遍，他手腕“恰好”一抖，纯度掉回七成五——这是“失手”。又补一遍，重新拉到八成，收手。

    整整一个多时辰。

    搁鼎里，半个时辰就成了。可这是“凡人手法”，就得有凡人手法的慢，和那份费劲。

    陈青山取出精铁，双手奉给柳如烟。

    她接过，翻看。

    “八成。”
content_en:
"Go in."

    Liu Qingshuang stopped in front of a quiet room without looking back.

    Chen Qingshan followed her all the way to the main peak with worries in mind. The higher you go, the colder you get, the spiritual energy is so thick that you feel oppressive, and the bluestone under your feet is replaced by spiritual rock, which is so smooth that it slips.

    Liu Qingshuang didn't say a word along the way, and he didn't dare to ask, so he just arrived at this quiet room in a muffled voice.

    He pushed the door open and the door hinge creaked.

    The quiet room is not big. There is a long table by the window. There are a few fragments of magical instruments scattered on the table. There is a small furnace next to it. The embers in the furnace have long been extinguished.

    There is a person standing by the window.

    Dressed in white, her long hair hangs down to her waist, pinned with only a wooden hairpin. Chen Qingshan only glanced at it and quickly lowered his head.

    Liu Ruyan.

    The chief disciple of Qifeng.

    He rarely even gets a chance to look at this kind of person from a distance, let alone get close. Today, she was standing in front of him, less than three feet away.

    Before he could speak, Liu Ruyan asked calmly:

    "Are you Chen Qingshan?"

    "Disciple Chen Qingshan has met Senior Sister Liu."

    Although he didn't know what was going on, he didn't dare to lack the proper etiquette. He bowed and bowed his head, not daring to look directly.

    Liu Ruyan didn't ask him to get up. She walked to the long desk and picked up a fragment of a useless weapon - the size of a palm, the surface was full of cracks, and the spiritual patterns were completely broken.

    "I heard that your method of refining waste weapons is very special."

    She handed over the fragment.

    "Practice it again in front of me."

    Chen Qingshan caught the fragment and his palms suddenly became sweaty.

    It's over.

    Practice in person.

    Can't use tripod.

    But he only panicked for a moment before forcing himself to calm down. He has practiced ordinary smelting techniques. During the days he came to Qi Peak, he dealt with the furnace every day and could go through the basic process with his eyes closed. The purity of the refined iron produced is naturally far inferior to that of the tripod, but at least it can compare.

    The important thing is - control the heat.

    Not too high, not too low. If it's too high, it'll be exposed; if it's too low, it'll be suspicious. A person who had previously handed over 90% refined iron could only produce 60% on the spot. Even a fool could tell that he was hiding.

    Eighty percent, just right.

    It was a bit lower than before. It could be said that "I lost my grip nervously in front of the chief", but it was not so low as to arouse suspicion.

    Chen Qingshan walked to the public furnace in the corner of the quiet room, activated his spiritual power, the flames rose, and the fragments were put into the furnace and slowly melted. Liu Ruyan and Liu Qingshuang stood aside and watched quietly. That gaze was like two needles piercing his back.

    He deliberately slowed down his hand.

    The first time, 70% came out. The second time, pull it to 80%. On the third time, he flicked his wrist "just right" and the purity dropped back to 75% - this was a "miss". Make up for it again, pull it back to 80%, and stop.

    For more than an hour.

    Put it in the tripod and it will be ready in half an hour. But this is an "ordinary method", so it has to be as slow and laborious as ordinary people's methods.

    Chen Qingshan took out the fine iron and offered it to Liu Ruyan with both hands.

    She took it and looked through it.

    "Eighty percent."
